summary: PicoCELA Inc., a Japanese foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its September 30, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting (US equivalent: special shareholder meeting). Holders approved all proposals, including a capital-surplus transfer, deficit offset, articles amendment, and election of four directors. Separately, independent director Mutsuko Oba resigned effective September 30, 2026, citing personal reasons. Turnout was 97.44%. The board now has seven directors. The filing is primarily a routine EGM result and board election notice; the auditor resignation was voluntary, not a forced sudden departure, so it is not classified as a special situation.
